reviews.text:
A wonderful place where they take such good care of our beloved dogs!

May God always bless them!

🤍🙏🏼🐾

The best doggy daycare for my furry friend!!!
At first, I was skeptical because my dog ​​was a bit shy and wasn't used to other dogs; but seeing how they care for them, the attention they give, and how happy she is to arrive and go in (she doesn't even look at me when I drop her off anymore) I love it. Plus, her socialization with other dogs and humans has improved a lot. They're very attentive to them and will let you know or send you a message about anything, often to share a funny photo or video; other times to remind you about her vaccinations and deworming. They even celebrated her birthday with her doggy friends. If I could give it more stars, I would! ✨️

You can see the love, patience, and attention they give to each dog. I took my Milo there and was so happy to know he's in the hands of people who truly love what they do. I highly recommend their service to anyone looking for a place where their furry friends will be treated with love and dedication. Thank you so much for taking such good care of Milo! Highly recommended!

My dog ​​Wera has been going to her school for over a year now and she loves it 🥰 It makes her very happy and you can tell they love her there. Thanks to Jorge, Karen L, Karen G, Wendy, and Saraí ✨ They do an excellent job. …

Excellent service!
My little Luna's behavior completely changed after her training. From the attention the staff gave us to the results, everything was excellent.
Highly recommend it!

Excellent service and attention to the dogs.
My dog ​​Mila and I, Alberto, always use their boarding facilities, and we've always had a great experience. My dog ​​always arrives at the kennel in perfect condition, without needing to be dragged, which I think means they treat her well. The only downside is that the prices are a little high.

I left my dog ​​at a kennel for a week and everything was great; they sent us photos and videos. Special thanks to Ms. Sarahi; she was very, very kind to both me and my dog, and I consider her an expert in canine psychology because even though my dog ​​is very restless, she calmed down with her.
Great service! They're always looking after my dog ​​and taking very good care of her! My dog ​​adores them!
My Pitseleh is happy with Sarai and her team. They are all very kind and treat all the dogs with great care. I've been going to Inteligencia Canina for 5 years and I'm very happy. Thank you!

My dog loves coming here every week. The staff all know her and take very good care of her. They often send pictures and videos to show her playing with other dogs. I’ve used the boarding service for several trips, including up to 10 days, and my dog came home healthy and happy. She’s always excited to go back!
The staff are amazing and they always take great care of my little one 👌🐶 …
They give the dogs lots of care and love. I've left my chihuahua, who is very skittish, and she manages to warm up to them. 🥰 …
My dog ​​loves coming here; she's always the happiest and most pampered. They provide excellent service, and every time she comes, we can rest assured that she's in the best hands.

My dog ​​has stayed here several times, and she always has a great time. She's very attached to us, so it's normal for her to feel anxious sometimes, but the entire Canine Intelligence team works hard to give her the love and care she needs so she doesn't miss us. The staff is very friendly and constantly checks on my dog ​​to see if she's eaten, played, and how she's doing overall. Saraí is very kind and communicates very clearly. I definitely highly recommend this location!

We've been using Canine Intelligence's services at their Salamanca branch for a year and a half now, and it's been a wonderful experience from day one. It's never easy leaving your dog in a new environment, but the affection, attention, and lovely treatment we've received from the start have given us so much peace of mind and confidence. We're very grateful to Saraí and the whole team, and we highly recommend them!

We love this place. My dog, Jack, has stayed many times, many nights, and we have had great experiences. The staff are wonderful and kind, and I always get lots of pictures, videos, and updates while I am traveling. Highly recommended.

Terrible place to take your dogs.
I don't know what it's like at other locations, but at this one specifically, the service is bad, the staff has a bad attitude, and the training for the price is mediocre. If you're going to pay for a service, make sure it's good and that the staff is properly trained. My dog ​​wasn't receiving the necessary attention and even got sick while there. The boarding service is also bad. If you have the opportunity to take your dogs there, don't. 👍🏻

Terrible service. I paid 30,000 pesos for the most expensive training and attended for 5 months, but they didn't teach me anything.

I don't recommend it; their follow-up is awful.

The service leaves much to be desired. Although the place is large, it feels cramped for the number of dogs they have.
When I called to inquire about the boarding facility, they told me it was important for my dogs to schedule an appointment beforehand so they could be examined, have their vaccination records checked, and so we could see the place and get them familiar with it, which I thought was unbelievable. I scheduled my appointment and we arrived.
The person who attended to us from the beginning was very rude, making faces at my dogs and giving us dirty looks. He gave us a half-hearted explanation and wouldn't let us see the place, saying it wasn't allowed. I told her that during the call we had been told one thing, but she was telling me something else, and she said, "Well, we don't do that here." During the explanation, she said, "Your dogs are going to get sick, it's normal, whether it's the flu or a stomach bug," and that was the first red flag. Then she insisted they be dewormed the same day they were going to arrive. I told her that didn't seem like the best idea since dewormers can temporarily cause diarrhea, vomiting, or discomfort, and she said that her vet did it that way and there was no problem—second red flag. Then we asked about the kennels, and she said we couldn't see them—third red flag. Later, I asked if the dogs could come in to see the place, and she said no, they would stay in the office because they would upset the pack, which I understand. But I did mention that during the call we had been told they could see the place. Finally, she said they could only come in to see the first screening area, nothing more. I went inside and wow, they have so many dogs that, while it's a large place, with so many of them it feels cramped for them to enjoy the space. I actually went to another place later; they have cameras everywhere, and the staff was incredibly kind to my dogs, which was my biggest concern. They checked them and their vaccination records, let us see the kennel where they would be staying, and explored the space. They mentioned that it was possible they might have diarrhea due to anxiety, but they never mentioned anything about the flu. And they were able to get used to the place, so really think twice before leaving your dogs there. They're very indifferent towards them and have too many for the people in charge.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Finding a place where you can leave your dog with complete peace of mind isn't easy, but since Camilo arrived, we feel we've found much more than just a doggy daycare.

I want to give a very special shout-out to Sarai. Her attention, professionalism, and the genuine affection she shows each dog are evident from day one. She has a tremendous sensitivity for understanding them and making them feel safe, and that gave us so much confidence as a family. (Thank you for loving and caring so much for your little guy 😉)

Camilo arrives happy, comes home relaxed, and we always see him excited when he knows he's going to school. Besides having fun, we've noticed very positive changes in his behavior and confidence. For us, that speaks volumes about the excellent work you do.

Thank you to the whole team for creating a space where dogs are treated with respect, patience, and so much love. The three of us (Camilo 🐕, my husband, and I) are true fans of your work and recommend you without hesitation. Thank you for taking care of Camilo as if he were part of your own family! 🐾 🫰🏻
I like how they treat my two babies, Aura and Mia. I used the hotel for both of them and it's clear they had a great time.
It's a safe place that cares about dogs. The attention and service are excellent, and the staff is very trustworthy. Highly recommended.

I've left my dog ​​at a kennel several times, and they always take great care of her. She ends up exhausted from playing so much, and they send me videos of her every day. I also leave her there occasionally during the day to play. I like it because my dog ​​always eats everything she finds on the street, and here there's nothing for her to eat, but she can have lots of fun.
I am very grateful to the branch; they take very good care of Bunny, and they are very grateful in return.
My Yukon is incredibly happy every time we take him. They treat him perfectly, and he always comes out very happy. Highly recommended.

My furry friend, Samuel, has found another family. They take excellent care of him, always keeping up with his vaccinations, deworming, and nail trimming. The service is truly excellent. It's all thanks to how incredibly well Samuel, my dog, gets along. They pamper him, he loves them, and they love him. He's also learned to socialize very well with other dogs, which is super important to me. His social behavior in parks and on the streets is very good, and that gives me peace of mind.
I left my dog ​​Lucas at the boarding kennel, the service was incredible, as was the stay. Lucas made friends and every time he's welcomed back he arrives very happy :)
Great price and excellent service, plus great customer service. 10/10

Excellent place to leave your dog. From day one, you can tell they truly love and care for them. My dog ​​gets along safely with other dogs, plays, goes out happily, and always comes back calm and content. Plus, it gives me great peace of mind to receive photos and videos throughout the day to check on him. The staff is very professional, caring, and attentive. You can tell they do this work out of love for sentient beings. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a place where their dog will be well cared for and happy.

Beka, my puppy, has been treated with great love and respect. They make sure all the dogs are vaccinated, dewormed, and up-to-date on their health care. She's happy and socializes with all the dogs at the shelter, so I trust their care, attention, and professionalism.
It's an excellent place for your pet

Excellent service, highly recommended. We left our dog Hoshi with them and they took wonderful care of him. The staff is incredibly attentive, caring, and professional. They sent us photos and kept us updated every step of the way. You can tell they love what they do. Hoshi came back happy and very calm. We will definitely be back!
Excellent service. They were friendly and have good prices.
I definitely recommend them; I wouldn't trust any other place to leave my dog. They are very good and attentive, highly recommended.

Thank you for taking such good care of our most loyal companions. I love the activities you do, like paw prints, our Father's Day puppy, our Mother's Day muffin, but above all, I love that you make them so happy. I started with training and then stayed at daycare because Mila wanted to keep playing.

I am eternally grateful to the entire Sarai team for their dedication and clear information, and to the caregivers Jorge, Karen, Wendy, and Karen because they are always so kind, and when they greet my little one, you can see how much she appreciates them. Thank you for loving them so much. 💖
Highly recommended
We took Max there and the experience has been great. They always greet them with so much patience and love. You can see the difference in them and we're very relieved to know they're in good hands.

Since Calisto started coming, we've seen so many changes. He's much more attentive now, gets along better with other dogs, and comes home happy every time. You can really see the love and dedication they give to everyone. We highly recommend them!

We took Chocorol and Popis there, and the experience has been very good. They are always received with great patience and love. You can see the difference in them, and we are very relieved to know they are in good hands.
We took Bruno and the experience was wonderful. They always greet them with so much patience and love. 100% recommended

We took Zeus there and the experience has been wonderful. They always receive them with so much patience and love. You can see the difference in them and we're very relieved to know they're in good hands.
Highly recommended, excellent service.

Since Canela started attending, we've seen so many changes. She's much more attentive now, gets along better with other dogs, and arrives happy every time. You can really see the love and dedication they give to everyone. We highly recommend them!
Excellent service, 100% recommended, excellent people
Blue loved the care she received from us! We highly recommend her!
The staff provides excellent, warm, and caring service to the dogs; it's definitely a great place for training and socializing with the dogs we love.

Since Maya started attending, we've seen so many changes. She's much more attentive now, gets along better with other dogs, and comes home happy every time. You can really see the love and dedication they give to everyone. We highly recommend them!

My dog ​​Wanda loves going to Canine Intelligence. They always greet her with so much love, and we feel at ease knowing she's in good hands. All the staff are very kind and professional. Thank you for taking such good care of our little one!
Excellent service 👌 I'm happy with them, very friendly staff 😊 …

We brought Sombra in because she had a lot of trouble getting along and integrating with other dogs. She completed two levels of training, and the change was enormous. Sarai's patience in explaining things to us was a huge help. Now we continue practicing everything we used to do ourselves, and we see her becoming more confident and sociable every day. 🐾

Something else we really appreciated was the way all the caregivers and the trainer treated her. Sometimes the videos took a little while to arrive, but we always understood that their priority was the dogs' care and well-being. Even so, we never missed our daily update, and that gave us a lot of peace of mind.

We would definitely trust them again when we return to Mexico City. Thank you for all the work and love you gave Sombra! 💜

We took Junior and Lisa there, and the experience has been wonderful. They are always received with great patience and love. The difference in them is noticeable, and we feel very reassured knowing they are in good hands.

A place filled with love and dedication for the dogs. You can see the affection, patience, and commitment with which they care for them. Thank you for providing them with a safe and loving space. Highly recommended! 🐶❤️ …

Miralda received training here and had a wonderful experience. Later, I left her little brother, Cafecito, at the boarding facility. He had never been around other dogs before, but the staff is very well-trained and made his integration gradual and very careful!

Miralda always gets excited when she returns to the boarding facility and sees her caregivers. The care they provide is excellent and very attentive! I highly recommend them!
Great place, they pamper the dogs, Karen provides excellent service.

We've been trusting Sarai and her team for a long time and have never had a bad experience. We understand that dogs often play and get into roughhousing, and yet they still report everything to us. There's always excellent service, cleanliness, and they treat the dogs incredibly well. Thank you for all the effort you put in every day and for the love you have for them; we see it at every celebration. 🥳🐾

More than just a place for dogs, it feels like a team that truly cares for them. From the moment they greet you and you see their tails wagging every time they walk in, it just means they're happy here.
They always welcome my Coco with so much love, and that makes all the difference. Thank you, Sarai, Karen, Wendy, and Jorge, for taking such good care of our best friends.
I took my little Bowie to stay at a boarding facility. The experience was quite pleasant; they returned him very happy, and the staff was very caring.
I don't recommend them; they don't take care of your dog and they don't take responsibility.
Good service, good with animals, my cat is happy with the treatment

Excellent service, very capable and clear in explaining step-by-step how to care for my pets. A highly knowledgeable person.

Thank you, Dr. Hector!

Hello,

I'd like to make a reservation. Do you have a booking link through the Agendaly.com app?

Nala is usually a bit wary of strangers, but when I went to pick her up, she was completely different: she came out happy, wagging her tail, tired from playing so much, and with a calmness that showed she had a wonderful time. She didn't show any signs of stress, which is very rare for her. I will definitely be back, and I've already recommended this boarding kennel to my friends at work. If you're truly looking for a responsible, caring, and professional place to leave your dog, this is, without a doubt, the best option.
I loved their attention and patience. Maya's change in behavior has been incredible. Very professional! 👍🏻 …

I'm so happy with the way they've treated my little Mila. She goes in super excited to daycare and ends up exhausted at the end of the day.
I'm so grateful to the caregivers and the manager for pampering and spoiling her!

Kira has been to other boarding facilities before, but I've never seen her come back so happy and relaxed. She arrived home tired from playing, happy, and without any sign of stress or nervousness. That, for me, is proof that she was cared for with genuine love and professionalism. I've already recommended the place to my friends from the park, and of course, I'll leave her here again without hesitation. If you're looking for a responsible and trustworthy boarding facility, look no further.

My dog ​​Luna came back happy, calm, and just the right amount of tired from all the playing. She was noticeably relaxed, with no stress at all. I will definitely be back, and I've already recommended it to several friends. For anyone looking for a place where they treat their dog with love, responsibility, and professionalism, this is the ideal spot.

Beware! They don't take care of your pet. One of their dogs had an accident and accidentally split her head open while "playing" with another dog who was sick (because she got sick there with other dogs). They dewormed her without consulting the owner. They charge you for everything, even things you didn't ask for!
They require a 13 kg bag of Total Canin dog food every week.

Hello Marielle, thank you for your feedback. We have forwarded it to the appropriate department for follow-up. At Canine Intelligence, our priority is the well-being of the dogs. Therefore, we constantly monitor our security cameras and closely monitor these types of comments, complaints, and suggestions. Any employees reported are immediately dismissed.

Update: Once the owners learned of our situation, they made sure Tonali was seen by another veterinarian who knew what she was doing. With her, Tonali recovered quite quickly. We are grateful for the excellent care and clear communication. I recommend having a clear conversation with the local people to find an effective solution.

Our experience with your service has been complicated. From the beginning, we trusted your care and training system, so we paid around $30,000 for three months of daycare and training. However, our dog got sick shortly after starting, even with all the vaccinations you administered. Now that we've picked her up to travel to Chicago, we were surprised to find she's sick again with the same illness.

We understand that dogs can get sick, but we don't think it's fair to hold us responsible when our dog contracted the illness at the school and Dr. Andrea assured us that his condition was mild and that he had a good chance of traveling with the treatment he received. If she had told us his condition was severe, then we wouldn't have been able to discuss it. Furthermore, this is the second time he's gotten sick at your facility, and the medications used haven't been effective.

We appreciate that you have a medical team, but we believe that if a dog gets sick under your care, it's your responsibility to provide the appropriate treatment, especially since we paid for the service for the entire three months and also covered the additional consultation.

We hope you can improve your health protocols to prevent other dogs from being put at unnecessary risk.

My dog ​​Horus is incredibly happy there. They started training him when he was a puppy, and now he's only in daycare, but he loves going. He gets so excited when he arrives and always comes back happy.

The trainer, Saraí, has an exceptional way with the dogs and clearly takes great care in her work and their care. I highly recommend her. Thank you for taking such good care of our fur babies.

They are so obedient thanks to the training levels, I hope if possible all the staff at the Roma Branch are recognized, especially the trainer Sarai and the veterinarian Andrea, I will never stop thanking them for Cocada and Trufa, they are sociable and balanced dogs ♡.

My dear Tonali is happy at the Salamanca branch and is progressing more each day in her training. Thank you all for your love.

Update:

A heartfelt thank you to the entire Canine Intelligence Salamanca team!

We are speechless with gratitude for all your attention and the genuine affection with which you welcomed Tonali from day one. It was very important to us that she felt safe, supported, and understood, and you achieved exactly that: making her feel right at home.

We also want to express our deepest gratitude for the effort and dedication you put into her training. We know that Xolos aren't always easy to train, but you worked with patience, respect, and love. A special thank you to Sarahi and Arturo, who guided Tonali with such sensitivity throughout her socialization process. It truly shows when someone does their job with heart.

We leave with the peace of mind that Tonali had the best possible experience, and we wholeheartedly recommend Inteligencia Canina Salamanca to anyone looking for a professional, responsible, and loving place for their dogs.

I contacted the company by phone and they gave me some information. The problem is that, without my consent, they bombard me with text messages offering deals and promotions. I tried to find out how to stop receiving them, but I couldn't find a way. I contacted them to try to stop receiving this spam, but I was unsuccessful.

I really hesitated to write a review, but since the service wasn't free, I decided to do it.
I left Benjamin for 3 nights and 4 days. It was a difficult decision since it was his first time at a boarding kennel. When I arrived and saw the place, everything seemed fine. The only thing I didn't like was that the space was too small for so many dogs (when I looked around, there were more than 30 dogs, approximately), but I thought, okay, that's fine.
They told me about their services, one of which was that they had water available 24/7, and they asked me what time he ate.
I dropped him off on a Saturday and picked him up on Tuesday. When I sent messages to check on him, they took hours to reply, until one day I got worried and called them. They answered, and the next day I messaged again, but they didn't reply. I called again, and they didn't answer the call, but they did reply to my message saying that he was fine and eating his normal food.

On Tuesday, when I picked him up, they told me he was super well-behaved and had "eaten almost all his kibble." When I greeted Benjamin and picked him up, I noticed he was thinner. Later, when we got to my house, I saw that the pouches of wet food in his bag were open and scattered around, as if he hadn't been fed.
Benjamin was very lethargic for five days. He didn't want to eat his kibble, so I had to cook for him. He also didn't want to play like he usually does. I was really scared, and I decided to take him to the vet on the first day because he vomited the day after I got him. The doctor said that the type of vomiting was due to him not eating, so they gave him an injection and gastrointestinal medication. They also weighed him, and he had lost weight. And supposedly he ate all his food? Another thing is, when he got home, he was dying of thirst. The first thing he did was drink water.
I would never leave him again.

Terrible place! Do they even realize that the dogs spend an estimated 7-8 hours there and they can't even give them the food you send (and they don't accept the diets they're used to)? For four days, they returned the food untouched, even after I emphasized this and assumed they would notice. Every day, I had to pick up Enzo crying (without knowing why) until I opened his lunchbox, and then, in the rush to get home, I had to feed him at least something he hadn't had all day, not even water. Today, I even strategically placed the food to check, and it's a fact: they don't even touch it. It's probably because they obviously have to clean more and they don't, since the place smells awful at night.

It's one thing for them to come back with a scratch or a bite, something natural within the pack, but keeping them without food the entire time they're there is just plain rude.
Excellent service
Very good experience, very friendly staff and completely professional service
Very good treatment of the furry ones
The staff were very friendly.
It's my Cuco's favorite place; he's happiest at this branch and seeing his friends. We always pick him up bursting with happiness.
I was just walking by and heard the trainer saying 'be quiet' and a dog whining a couple of times while another one with a husky voice barked

Hi everyone, I want to confess that it was really hard for me to leave Max at daycare for three days because he's so loved and spoiled. I read some reviews that made me hesitate, but I decided to go ahead and I left feeling incredibly happy and satisfied with how Max and I were treated! Saraí and Arturo were so kind and gentle, they answered all my questions, sent me videos constantly, and kept me updated on whether he was eating well and playing. They always had a smile and were so kind to me, always answering my questions like, "How is he?" "Has he eaten yet?" Arturo was sending me videos of Max from 8 am, and the day I went to pick him up, he didn't want to come with me. As soon as I arrived, I saw him playing with a ball with one of his caregivers! Thank you so much for your kind attention, and I won't hesitate to return! Thank you so much! 🙏🙏
I took my dog ​​to a boarding kennel for vacation, and when I returned, I found him skin and bones and extremely weak. Thankfully, he's recovering now, but I will never take him to that place again.
Everyone is always so kind and careful with my Peperonni. We feel very safe and happy every time we leave him at the boarding kennel. And he comes out very happy. Thank you so much. 🐾💖💖😊 …
They've always been very careful with our dogs. I've been using their boarding service for many years.

I took my Belgian Shepherd to basic training for a month and was delighted with everything he learned. When I had to return to the facility for the change of command, Argos (my dog) loved the trainer Sarai, as did everyone else there, because of the kindness and love they show the animals.

Thank you all for the videos you kindly sent me daily so I could see how my dog ​​was behaving, how he was adapting, and the loving care he received. I highly recommend this service.
My puppy stayed 6 days at the daycare, her first time, they sent us a video every day and she looked very happy.

Jack loves his doggy daycare. He's been going to this location since he was a tiny puppy and has a blast. He's very fond of his caregivers and always goes in happy. They're all incredibly kind to both the owners and the dogs. It's the only doggy daycare I wholeheartedly recommend.

I take my dog ​​Neema twice a week, and she always comes back tired and happy after playing all day. I can't speak to the experience of other dogs, but my dog ​​is very calm and used to the doggy daycare; she plays well with other dogs. Sarai and her team take great care of her and send me lovely photos. They even threw a beautiful birthday party for another dog! They are very strict about vaccinations, which I appreciate. Thank you, Canine Intelligence!
They were always attentive to my little one and very kind to him, an excellent choice when traveling.

My dogs love going to doggy daycare. I took one of them to the obedience course, and it was really good: he was happy to go to the lessons, and it helped him learn to control himself better. Highly recommended!

My daughter finished all her courses, and the difference was noticeable. Now she's in daycare and always leaves and arrives happy. At home, she behaves very well. I have no negative comments; on the contrary, they are always attentive, sending photos of her progress and answering any questions you might have. I definitely recommend them.

I asked for information and they told me that it depends on the dog's breed whether it can be in their doggy daycare. All they really showed was their inability to handle dogs.

They never even saw my dog, a medium-sized dog weighing 15 kg. They accept larger dogs and give these kinds of answers.
We love this place; every time we take our dog, he arrives and leaves happy. The service is excellent.

I don't recommend this place. My dog ​​arrived healthy, and halfway through his "training," he just happened to lose a tooth. He was sick... When he graduated, several other dogs who were supposed to graduate with him were dead, and others were injured.

If you love your dog, don't bring him to any dog ​​training center. I don't recommend it. You can find all the complaints on Facebook with photos and evidence.

I am staying next door to this dog school and the dogs are barking 24/7 even late into the night. They sound distressed and like they are not being properly cared for. It is scary and after reading reviews about people witnessing physical abuse to the dogs I am shocked that owners willingly leave their pets here.
I wrote for reports because I wanted to enroll my puppies and the first thing I see is a review that they kicked a dog and the place accepts it, terrible.
Thank you for your rating Brayan, we are still at your service 🐶💕 …
Thank you for your rating Pepe, we are still at your service 🐶💕 …
Thank you for your rating, Angel. We're still at your service! 🐶💕 …

My experience was very good overall! Whenever I asked for videos, they sent them to me the same day, even if they were busy. I gave them 4 stars because I think the entertainment is much more expensive than in other places, but they always …

Discrimination — I was going to take my dog ​​and asked for information about their daycare service. They told me that they only accept dogs of my breed up to 8 months old. It's unbelievable that they're dedicated to pet care and …
Hi Alberto, thank you for your rating. We're still at your service 🐶💕 …

Hi Carlos, we'd like to hear about your experience so we can improve our service. Please send an email to atencionalcliente@inteligenciacanina.com with your information and your dog's details so we can follow up.

After reading the way the company representative responded, this place is a red flag. I would never leave my dog ​​in this company's hands, especially since they can't speak up and say if they're being abused or mistreated. Above all, the …
Good care for the dogs.

I had a very bad experience. I left my dog ​​and they returned her to me skin and bones, trembling with fear, and she didn't want the boy who was taking care of her to approach her, which is unusual for her, since she is affectionate and always approaches everyone, especially those she has a lot of contact with.
